# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through GitHub: open the Security tab of this repository and choose "Report a vulnerability". Please do not report a vulnerability in a public issue, a discussion or a pull request.

## Supported versions

The supported version is the newest release.

## Security model

How CuliBox protects a machine, and what it does not protect, is described in [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md).
